commands.config_validation: PYTHONPATH="$PWD" uv run --no-project --with pyyaml python -m aimanager.scripts.validate_config aimanager/config.yaml
commands.test_suite: PYTHONPATH="$PWD" uv run --no-project --with pytest --with pyyaml pytest aimanager/tests -q
commands.live_ycapi_preflight: PYTHONPATH="$PWD" uv run --no-project python -m aimanager.scripts.smoke_live_ycapi --expect-model gemini-2.5-flash --expect-model deepseek-chat --expect-model ycapi-image-1
commands.lightweight_web: PYTHONPATH="$PWD" uv run --no-project --with uvicorn python -m aimanager.scripts.run_lightweight_web --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4002 --business-base-url http://localhost:4000
